defs.def: covered with snow 被雪覆盖的

ex.s: The landscape that lines the route is beautiful and dramatic, with snowy mountains and green valleys.
ex.t: 沿途的风景美丽而壮观，有雪山和翠绿的山谷。

ex.s: There were forests, mountains with snowy tops and masses of ice.
ex.t: 有森林、有雪顶的高山和大量的冰块。

ex.s: Among Frost’s best-known poems are The Road Not Taken, Fire and Ice, Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening and Birches.
ex.t: 弗罗斯特最著名的诗歌包括《未选择的路》《火与冰》《雪夜林边小驻》和《桦树》。

ex.s: However, during the winter, it is difficult to attract the animals to cameras hidden in snowy forests.
ex.t: 然而，在冬天，很难吸引动物到藏在雪林中的相机前。

defs.def: when a lot of snow falls 一段时间

ex.s: It is the first fall we have had here this winter, and last year I was out of the country, sweating in a hot climate, during the snowy season, so that it really does seem an age since saw the ground so fantastically carpeted.
ex.t: 这是我们今年冬天这里下的第一场雪，去年冬天我出国了，在炎热的气候里汗流浃背，错过了下雪的季节，所以看起来真的好像很多年没有见过大地铺满如此美妙的雪毯了。

defs.def: very white, like new snow 雪白的
